chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman around 27, wearing a teal headscarf and a long lilac cardigan over a white blouse
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a Moroccan woman around 40, wearing a burgundy headscarf and a beige kaftan with a striped kitchen apron
chars.BROTHER: BROTHER: a Moroccan man around 38, bald with a grey stubble, wearing an olive-green bomber jacket over a black t-shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the kitchen doorway of a modest Moroccan family home: SISTER, mid-gesture, wooden spoon in hand, leans toward NARRATOR and insists with raised eyebrows, demanding something; NARRATOR stands surprised by the fridge. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, steaming pot on the stove behind.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: WIFE in a small traditional Moroccan kitchen of the old parents' house, wearing an apron over her cardigan, carrying a heavy tray of tea and bread toward a low salon table where an elderly Moroccan couple in djellabas sit, a little overwhelmed expression.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the parents' cramped Moroccan kitchen, a woman in a maroon headscarf kneads a big bowl of bread dough on the floor while SISTER stirs a pot, both busy with weekly housework for the old parents, flour on their hands.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On a Moroccan rooftop terrace with laundry lines at dusk, BROTHER takes NARRATOR aside, one hand on his shoulder and a finger raised in a serious warning; NARRATOR listens, unsure.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan salon with low banquette sofas and patterned cushions, BROTHER explains passionately, counting points on his fingers, while NARRATOR sits on the sofa holding a glass of mint tea, thinking hard.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the old parents' modest Moroccan living room, SISTER pours tea for her elderly father in a white djellaba and mother in a brown djellaba, caring and dutiful, warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a small newlyweds' Moroccan apartment, WIFE smiles gently and nods yes to NARRATOR, who looks relieved and happy, both sitting at a small dining table in the evening.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At the door of a Moroccan apartment at night, WIFE still in a flour-dusted apron, tears on her cheeks, exhausted, stands crying in front of NARRATOR who looks shocked and worried.
